units.source_text: 千重子把母亲请到厨房，让她看了从市场上买来的东西。

en.t: Chieko invited her mother into the kitchen and showed her the things she had bought at the market.

units.source_text: 母亲看到女儿从篮子里拿出来摆好的东西，暗自想道：

en.t: Seeing the things her daughter had taken from the basket and laid out, her mother thought to herself:
This child has learned to be thrifty too.

units.source_text: 也可能是因为父亲到嵯峨尼姑庵去了，不在家……

en.t: Perhaps it was because her father had gone to the convent in Saga and was not at home...
